title: Parallel tests lose artifacts when a bare SQLite tracking URI falls back to shared ./mlruns
answers: tests fail randomly under pytest-xdist because artifacts disappear
artifacts from one test worker deleted by another worker
default experiment artifact location points to ./mlruns in tests
flaky SQLite tracking store tests with missing artifact files
body:
Symptom: Under parallel (xdist) test runs, a test's logged artifacts vanish or fail to write because another worker's cleanup removed them.
Root cause: tests/conftest.py:cached_db used to bake a Default experiment with an artifact location into the cache, and a bare SQLite tracking URI without an explicit artifact root fell back to the repo-root ./mlruns, which the autouse clean-up fixture deletes after each test.
Fix pattern: Keep the session cache schema-only (initialize via _initialize_tables and dispose the engine in finally). In tests/conftest.py:db_uri, insert the Default experiment into each per-test copy with an artifact location under that test's tmp_dir, including timestamps and the default workspace.
Constraints: Applies to tests that open a SQLite copy through the db_uri fixture. Does not cover tests that pass an explicit artifact root to the store. Do not reintroduce a Default experiment row into cached_db.
applies: Test fixtures in tests/conftest.py that build SQLite tracking databases; tracing-only and missing-dependency guards still apply.
says: Automated test runs fail intermittently with missing artifact errors when executed in parallel
Logged experiment outputs randomly disappear during concurrent test suite execution
Parallel test workers delete shared artifact files created by other running tests
Ensure each parallel test worker saves logged files to an isolated temporary folder
search: In tests/conftest.py, SQLite tracking test fixtures must keep the cached_db session cache schema-only and assign Default experiment artifact locations to per-test temporary directories in db_uri. This prevents parallel pytest-xdist workers from falling back to repo-root ./mlruns and deleting logged artifacts during per-test cleanups. Tables are initialized via _initialize_tables with engines disposed in finally blocks, while per-test Default experiment rows include timestamps and default workspaces; this does not cover tests providing an explicit artifact root.
